WITH claim_losses AS (
    SELECT
        c.Insurable_Object_Identifier,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ca.Claim_Identifier) AS claims_count,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
              OR lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL
            THEN ca.Claim_Amount
        END) AS incurred_losses
    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim" AS c
    JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_amount" AS ca
        ON ca.Claim_Identifier = c.Claim_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_payment" AS lp
        ON lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_reserve" AS lr
        ON lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier = ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier
    GROUP BY c.Insurable_Object_Identifier
),
property_premium AS (
    SELECT
        pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier,
        SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS written_premium
    FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_amount" AS pa
    JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."premium" AS pr
        ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
    JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_coverage_detail" AS pcd
        ON pcd.Effective_Date = pa.Effective_Date
       AND pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
    GROUP BY pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier
)
SELECT
    cl.Insurable_Object_Identifier,
    la.Line_1_Address,
    cl.incurred_losses / NULLIF(pp.written_premium, 0) AS incurred_loss_to_premium_ratio
FROM claim_losses AS cl
JOIN property_premium AS pp
    ON pp.Insurable_Object_Identifier = cl.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."insurable_object" AS io
    ON io.Insurable_Object_Identifier = cl.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."geographic_location" AS gl
    ON gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier = io.Geographic_Location_Identifier
JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."location_address" AS la
    ON la.Location_Address_Identifier = gl.Location_Address_Identifier
WHERE cl.claims_count > 0
ORDER BY incurred_loss_to_premium_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 500
